Facebook connection is available for development; LinkedIn and AI integrations are pending.
Keys are encrypted with an Android Keystore key and sent directly to the matching provider only. They never pass through the SocialPilot server, are excluded from backups and are only shown masked.
Key %1$s saved, not yet confirmed by the provider.
Key %1$s was rejected: wrong or revoked. Please enter a new key.
Key %1$s is not allowed to use this API/model. Check the project and permissions at the provider.
The saved key cannot be read (the device keystore changed). Please enter it again or delete it.
The provider is rate limiting, so the key could not be confirmed. Try again later.
The provider is having problems, so the key could not be confirmed.
The check timed out, so the key could not be confirmed. Try again later.
Network error, so the key could not be confirmed. The key is not treated as wrong.
Unexpected response (network or proxy). The key could not be confirmed.
The device is offline. The key is stored safely; check again when online.
The key changed during the check; the old result was ignored.
Invalid key: it must be 20–512 characters without spaces.
Could not save the key to secure storage. Please retry.
Could not delete the key. Please retry.

This is the app\'s estimate from the pinned price sheet, not a provider invoice. Calls with missing usage are never counted as 0.
